description.value: COFU Pressed Sushi is a 100% plant-based pressed sushi restaurant near the entrance to Granville Island, founded by Akiko Otsuka and open since fall 2021. The menu features inventive vegan interpretations of sushi classics — jackfruit tuna and konjac salmon — with a near-zero food waste philosophy and eco-friendly, recyclable packaging. The restaurant is alcohol-free and encourages guests to bring their own containers for takeout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number (604-730-7999) and address (1833 Anderson Street), confirming the business is open and operating. The website explicitly states 'ALL Plant-Based' and OSM tags diet:vegan=only, confirming the vegan/vegetarian amenity; it also confirms both dine-in and takeout ('DINE-IN & TAKEOUT') plus delivery via Uber Eats and SkipTheDishes. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom evidence appears in either source.
concerns: OSM address field omits unit number (103); full address should be 103-1833 Anderson Street per OSM addr:unit tag.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible vegan sushi restaurant near Granville Island — a high-traffic cycling destination — with confirmed takeout and a fully plant-based menu that serves a distinct dietary niche for touring cyclists.
